description: Source code for the implementation of the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) optimizer in PyTorch, including class definition, initialization, and functional API for optimization steps.

classes.name: SGD
classes.description: Implementation of the stochastic gradient descent optimizer with support for momentum, dampening, weight decay, Nesterov momentum, and fused operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for SGD optimizer, initializes hyperparameters and checks for valid values.

methods.name: __setstate__
methods.description: Restores the state of the optimizer, setting default values for certain parameters.

methods.name: _init_group
methods.description: Initializes parameter groups, collects parameters, gradients, and momentum buffers.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Performs a single optimization step, calling the functional sgd API.
